Create a Comp 1920 by 1080p. In it a dot matrix LED screen using small white circles. Make it so the edges of the outermost dots are touching the edges of the comp (the comp itself is the LED screen. The padding between dots is consistent (whatever the math gives us). I want around 500 dots. Have them scale in from the center out with bounce to 100% their size. 

Then play two text beats. Draw every letter using the dots themselves Bright Red. 

The beats, in order:

Beat 1: HOLA single centered line  
Beat 2: MOTIONAMIGO scrolls from right to left

Dots that ARE part of a letter scale to 100%
Dots that are NOT part of a letter  scale to 25%
Do NOT use text layers. Every letter must be drawn by the dots themselves. Every dot should be its own shape layer.
